title: 1× exception raised without `from` in except block (W0707, first at line 103)
detail: At 1 location(s) (first at line 103), a new exception is raised inside an `except` block without `raise ... from original_exc`. This discards the original traceback and makes debugging harder. Fix: `raise NewExc(...) from exc` to preserve the chain.

title: Builtin `id` shadowed by local variable (W0622)
detail: Local variable(s) at lines 94, 131, 139, 147 shadow the builtin(s) id. If the builtin is needed elsewhere in the same scope, the shadowing causes a confusing `TypeError` or silent misbehavior. Fix: rename the local variable to avoid shadowing.

title: 10× unused argument (W0613) — e.g. `req`, `body`, `req`
detail: 10 function arguments are never used within their function bodies. This often signals an interface mismatch or a method that should be `@staticmethod`. Fix: use the argument, or prefix with `_` if it's an intentionally unused interface slot.
